action.permissions.reason: approval gates surface as input interactions

action.tools.reason: tool.start/complete only; started synthesized; failures ride in result without a pinned discriminator

capabilities.reason: conservative descriptor for the pinned gateway

protocol.initialize.reason: gateway.ready frame with replay epoch before any input

run.cancel.reason: session.interrupt intent; settlement via message.complete interrupted

run.replay.reason: bounded adapter journal; gaps are explicit and the native events.since ring is not consulted

run.resume.reason: the native recovery family is not exercised; OAP resume replays the adapter journal

run.streaming.reason: immediate frames on stdio; post-scrubber provenance disclosed

session.compaction.policy.reason: compression is config.yaml under HERMES_HOME, which also holds the gateway's credentials, and no gateway method sets it

session.message.delivery.auto.reason: accepted only for known idle sessions

session.message.delivery.queue.reason: busy statuses are rejected rather than guessed

session.message.delivery.steer.reason: native session.steer not exposed in v1

session.message.submit.reason: status-only result; ownership by construction via message.start

session.open.reason: session.create mints the runtime session id

session.open.reopen.reason: session.resume reloads the bound stored session; one Hermes would auto-continue after a crash is refused and its process ended, taking the scheduled turn with it

session.reasoning.reason: session.create's reasoning_effort, then config.set reasoning scoped to the session, which validates it and sets it again between runs; off is Hermes's none

session.state.reason: reducer-owned live projection corroborated by session.info

user_input.reason: approval/clarify/sudo/secret server requests, withdrawn by request.cancel
